ngine. I've created my project and have the transect, segment, and observa=

Jennifer

Here is a quick (and possibly incomplete) answer. To use the DSM engine =

you need to have fitted your detection function using the MRDS engine=20
(not the MCDS engine). You can still incorporate covariates into your=20
detection function using MRDS. Perhaps that might be the reason for the =

error message.
